description.zh: 输入待卸载的系统插件名称。
description.en: The names of the system plug-ins that you want to uninstall.

description.zh: 用于保证请求的幂等性。由客户端生成该参数值，要保证在不同请求间唯一，最大不超过64个ASCII字符。
description.en: A unique token that is used to ensure idempotence. This parameter value is generated by the client and must be unique among different requests. The value can be up to 64 ASCII characters in length.

description.zh: 是否强制卸载。可取消安装正在安装中的插件，仅限于新架构实例。默认值：false。
description.en: Specifies whether to forcefully uninstall the plug-in. You can cancel the installation of a plug-in that is being installed. This parameter is applicable only to instances of the new architecture. Default value: false.
